description: UltraBERT-150M full fine-tune, distilled: soft targets = 7.7k LLM labels (4.5k reused v1 seeded deepseek-v4.1-flash labels with v1 seeds + 3.2k new flash labels with the v2 seeds; prompt chosen on dev: flash+seeds 0.875 > flash plain 0.830, flash+guidelines 0.850, deepseek-v4-pro 0.835) plus pseudo-labels for the other 41k pool pairs from the average of two UltraBERT teachers trained on the 7.7k labels (dev 0.865/0.860, ensemble 0.875). Student lr 1.15e-5, 3 epochs, bs 32, max_len 128, early stop on held-out silver; dev 0.890 for both seeds (seed 0 frozen). ONNX with partial dynamic int8 (all MatMuls int8 except attention act-x-act matmuls and mlp.down_proj, which break UltraBERT int8): dev 0.885. Threshold 0.5.
